text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Twinkle Series now behind us, things have started to settle down. One day…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: And this is the pool! Isn't it huge?!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Wow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser has been tasked with guiding prospective students around during the academy's open campus.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Geez, youngins everywhere you look.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh! I'm gonna put them through the ringer next year!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I didn't realize you were one of the open campus organizers, Tannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm not, actually! The director just asked me to help out! Ehe!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: A direct request from Director Akikawa? That's quite uncommon.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Well, ummm…

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Tannhauser is a big inspiration for us, so the director wanted to give us the chance to meet her in person!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: One thing led to another, and now she's showing us around campus!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yup! She's just as friendly and approachable as she seems on TV… It's like a dream come true!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: She was so cool in the Arima Kinen! We all want to be just like her!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Haha, looks like someone's got her own fan club.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I appreciate it, but I think it'd be better if you looked up to someone more special.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: There's loads of talented racers here that are way more impressive than I am.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Once you enroll here, you'll see what I mean!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: No thanks. I'm happy with you, Tannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: I want to be someone who's friendly and who inspires courage in others—just like you!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Even the director said that you're amazing!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: …You mean it? Well, in that case…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe… I'm really happy to hear that.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah, there she is! Hey, Director!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I just thought I'd let you know that I finished the tour!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I heard! You have my gratitude! Everyone was thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It was nothing. If anything, they were the ones who made my day.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But um… there's something I've been wanting to ask you. It's been bothering me for a while, to be honest.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Why have you been so interested in me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've gotten used to it now, but the director occasionally shows up to encourage Matikanetannhauser and tell her she expects a lot from her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's held Matikanetannhauser in high regard for a long time now.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I get that you want to encourage an ordinary Umamusume like me, but still…

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I see… I was concerned that it would place unnecessary pressure on you if I went into too much detail!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Thus, I remained vague. However, now that you've grown so much, I believe the time is right for me to reveal the truth!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Our academy is filled with countless talented Umamusume! We're well known for our rigorous enrollment process!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: However, no matter your skills, there is always someone better!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Behind every victor who claims glory lie the defeated, tormented by a sense of powerlessness! Because of that…

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Many racers become convinced their skills are simply ordinary! Eventually, their performance declines, and they lose hope for the future!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: The fault falls on no one! Yet, as director of this academy, it rends my heart asunder!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: But then there's you! You alone!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: You believe yourself ordinary, yet your skills don't regress. Even when you are beaten down by the ultra-talented, you bounce back with aplomb!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: That is why I placed my hopes on you! I wanted you to become a lodestar for all those Umamusume who label themselves as ordinary!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: And you've lived up to my expectations spectacularly!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I'm sure you must have felt it yourself during the open campus today! There are many who aspire to be like you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wait, you don't mean… That's why you asked me to guide them around?!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Though again, it is not because I wanted to pressure you!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I simply wish for you to continue racing in your perfectly ordinary, carefree way—just as you've done until now!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whew… I didn't expect the director to get that fired up.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: …You know what? Having others believe in you doesn't feel so bad.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: The Umamusume who came to the open campus were all so bright and cheerful…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It makes me want to live up to their expectations. So… let's do our best together, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All right! Now that that's settled, it's time to train! Which reminds me, I reworked my schedule last night!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Tell me what you think!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser hands me her notebook which, as usual, is filled margin to margin with her training plan.
choice_data_list: Isn't this working a little too hard?
Isn't this working a little too hard?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What are you talking about?! This is totally normal!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser is the same as ever, and it doesn't look like our time together will be ending any time soon.
